questions.content:
单极介质球

如图，有一个半无穷长的密绕螺线管，通有恒定电流 $I$，单位长度的匝数为 $n$，螺线管半径为 $a$。有一个均匀介质小球，相对磁导率为 $\mu_r$，半径为 $b$。本问题中，小球到螺线管顶部的距离 $r \gg a, b$，不考虑重力。

(1)求介质球在任意处时，受到的磁力。

(2)若初态时，介质球位于螺线管正上方 $r_0$ 处，具有向上的初速度 $v_0$，求接下来的运动过程中，介质球到螺线管顶部的距离的最大值。

(3)现介质球带有净电荷 $q$。若初态时介质球位于螺线管正上方 $r_0$ 处，具有初速度 $v_0 = (\sqrt{3} + 1)nIa^2\sqrt{\frac{\pi(\mu_r - 1)\mu_0 b^3}{6mr_0^4}}$ 且与正上方夹角 $\alpha_0 = 3\pi/4$，求它到螺线管顶部的最小距离 $r_{\min}$ 以及到达最小距离的时间 $t_{\min}$。

![](data/images/2024-39573c51/2024-启慧研习院-力学-试卷-电磁学十力学-1.jpg)
questions.analysis:
$$\Phi = \pi a^{2} \cdot \mu_{0} n I \quad [4']\tag{1}$$

小球的极化近似于均匀场中的极化。小球处的磁场为

$$H = \frac{\Phi}{4 \pi \mu_0 r^2} = \frac{n I a^2}{4 r^2} \quad [4']\tag{2}$$

其磁化强度为 $M = ( \mu _ { r } - 1 ) H$ ，总偶极矩为

$$m = \hat { r } M \cdot \frac { 4 \pi } { 3 } b ^ { 3 } = \hat { r } ( \mu _ { r } - 1 ) \frac { \pi n I a ^ { 2 } b ^ { 3 } } { 3 r ^ { 2 } } \quad [ 4 ^ { \prime } ]\tag{3}$$

不均匀磁场中，其受力为

$$F = m \cdot \nabla B = ( \mu _ { r } - 1 ) \frac { \pi n I a ^ { 2 } b ^ { 3 } } { 3 r ^ { 2 } } \frac { \mathrm { d } } { \mathrm { d } r } \frac { \pi \mu _ { 0 } n I a ^ { 2 } b ^ { 3 } } { 4 r ^ { 2 } } = - \frac { \pi } { 6 } ( \mu _ { r } - 1 ) \mu _ { 0 } n ^ { 2 } I ^ { 2 } a ^ { 4 } b ^ { 3 } r ^ { - 5 }\tag{4}$$

(2) 上一问中的磁力对应势能

$$V _ { B } ( r ) = \int _ { r } ^ { \infty } \mathrm { d } r F ( r ) = - \frac { \pi } { 2 4 } ( \mu _ { r } - 1 ) \mu _ { 0 } n ^ { 2 } I ^ { 2 } a ^ { 4 } b ^ { 3 } r ^ { - 4 } \quad [ 4 ^ { \prime } ]\tag{5}$$

系统总能量为

$$E = V _ { B } ( r _ { 0 } ) + \frac { 1 } { 2 } m v _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } = V _ { B } ( r ) \quad [ 4 ^ { \prime } ]\tag{6}$$

若 $\begin{array} { r } { | v _ { 0 } | \geq \sqrt { \frac { \pi ( \mu _ { r } - 1 ) \mu _ { 0 } b ^ { 3 } } { m } } n I a ^ { 2 } r _ { 0 } ^ { - 2 } } \end{array}$ ，则小球运动至无穷远处；否则

$$r _ { \mathrm { m i n } } = ( r _ { 0 } ^ { - 4 } + \frac { 1 2 m v _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } } { \pi ( \mu _ { r } - 1 ) \mu _ { 0 } n ^ { 2 } I ^ { 2 } a ^ { 4 } b ^ { 3 } } ) ^ { - 1 / 4 } \quad [ 4 ^ { \prime } ]\tag{7}$$

(3)洛伦兹力不会改变角动量的大小，对径向运动方程没有影响，故仍然可以给出有效势。

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}|L|}{\mathrm{d}t} = 0 \quad [2']\tag{8}$$

总有效势为

$$V_{\mathrm{eff}}(r) = V_{B}(r) + \frac{L_{0}^{2}}{2m}r^{-2} = -\frac{\pi}{24}(\mu_{r} - 1)\mu_{0}n^{2}I^{2}a^{4}b^{3}r^{-4} + \frac{m(v_{0}\sin\alpha_{0}r_{0})^{2}}{2}r^{-2}\tag{9}$$

令 $A = \frac { \pi } { 2 4 } ( \mu _ { r } - 1 ) \mu _ { 0 } n ^ { 2 } I ^ { 2 } a ^ { 4 } b ^ { 3 }$

$$V _ { \mathrm { e f f } } ( r ) = A [ \frac { 4 + 2 \sqrt { 3 } } { r _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } r ^ { 2 } } - \frac { 1 } { r ^ { 4 } } ]\tag{10}$$

平衡点满足:

$$\frac { \mathrm { d } } { \mathrm { d } r } V _ { \mathrm { e f f } } ( r ) | _ { r = r _ { \mathrm { m } } } = A [ - \frac { 8 + 4 \sqrt { 3 } } { r _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } r _ { \mathrm { m } } ^ { 3 } } + \frac { 4 } { r _ { \mathrm { m } } ^ { 5 } } ] = 0\tag{11}$$

$$r_{\mathrm{m}}=\frac{\sqrt{6}-\sqrt{2}}{2} r_{0} \quad[2^{\prime}]\tag{12}$$

在最近处，径向动能为0，

$$V _ { \mathrm { e f f } } ( r _ { 0 } ) + \frac { 1 } { 2 } m v _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } \cos \alpha _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } = V _ { \mathrm { e f f } } ( r _ { \mathrm { m i n } } )\tag{13}$$

$$\frac{3 + 2\sqrt{3}}{r_{0}^{4}} + \frac{4 + 2\sqrt{3}}{r_{0}^{4}} = \frac{4 + 2\sqrt{3}}{r_{0}^{2}r_{\min}^{2}} - \frac{1}{r_{\min}^{4}}\tag{14}$$

解得

$$r_{\min }=\frac{\sqrt{6}-\sqrt{2}}{2} r_{0} \geq r_{\mathrm{m}} \quad[2']\tag{15}$$

4

因此介质球不会坠入力心。

$$\frac{1}{2}mv_{\mathrm{r}}^{2}+V_{\mathrm{eff}}(r)=V_{\mathrm{eff}}(r_{\min})\tag{16}$$

得到

$$v _ { r } = \sqrt { \frac { 2 A } { m } } ( \frac { 1 } { r ^ { 2 } } - \frac { 2 + \sqrt { 3 } } { r _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } } ) \quad [ 2 ^ { \prime } ]\tag{17}$$

通过积分得到时间

$$t_{\min }=\int_{r_{0}}^{r_{\mathrm{m}}} \frac{\mathrm{d} r}{v_{r}}=\sqrt{\frac{m}{2 A}} \int_{r_{0}}^{r_{\mathrm{m}}} \frac{\mathrm{d} r}{\frac{1}{r^{2}}-\frac{2+\sqrt{3}}{r_{0}^{2}}} \rightarrow \infty \quad[2^{\prime}]\tag{18}$$

到达最近点所需的时间是无穷大。

questions.answer:
**（1）** 半无限细螺线管等价于磁单极子，总磁通量 $\Phi = \pi a^{2} \mu_{0} n I$；小球处磁场 $H = \frac{n I a^2}{4 r^2}$，磁化强度 $M = (\mu_r - 1)H$，总偶极矩 $m = \hat{r}(\mu_r - 1)\frac{\pi n I a^2 b^3}{3r^2}$，受力 $F = -\frac{\pi}{6}(\mu_r - 1)\mu_0 n^2 I^2 a^4 b^3 r^{-5}$。

**（2）** 磁力对应势能 $V_B(r) = -\frac{\pi}{24}(\mu_r - 1)\mu_0 n^2 I^2 a^4 b^3 r^{-4}$；若 $|v_0| \geq \sqrt{\frac{\pi(\mu_r - 1)\mu_0 b^3}{m}} n I a^2 r_0^{-2}$，小球运动至无穷远；否则 $r_{\min} = \left(r_0^{-4} + \frac{12 m v_0^2}{\pi(\mu_r - 1)\mu_0 n^2 I^2 a^4 b^3}\right)^{-1/4}$。

**（3）** 洛伦兹力不改变角动量大小，有效势 $V_{\mathrm{eff}}(r) = -\frac{\pi}{24}(\mu_r - 1)\mu_0 n^2 I^2 a^4 b^3 r^{-4} + \frac{m(v_0 \sin\alpha_0 r_0)^2}{2} r^{-2}$；平衡点 $r_m = \frac{\sqrt{6}-\sqrt{2}}{2} r_0$；最近距离 $r_{\min} = \frac{\sqrt{6}-\sqrt{2}}{2} r_0 \geq r_m$，介质球不会坠入力心；径向速度 $v_r = \sqrt{\frac{2A}{m}}\left(\frac{1}{r^2} - \frac{2+\sqrt{3}}{r_0^2}\right)$，到达最近点所需时间为无穷大。

questions.content:
解答:

Part A

(1)在板间流体满足方程，设速度为 $u = u(x,t)$
questions.analysis:
$$\eta \frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial x^{2}} = \rho \frac{\partial u}{\partial t}\tag{1}$$

(1.1) 明显流体间 u 不随时间改变

$$\frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial x^{2}} = 0 \Rightarrow u = Cx + D\tag{2}$$

代入边界条件:

$$\left\{ \begin{aligned} { } & { { } u _ { ( 0 ) } = v _ { 0 } } \\ { } & { { } u _ { ( d ) } = v } \\ { } & { { } \left. \eta \frac { \partial u } { \partial x } \right| _ { x = d } = - k v _ { 0 } } \\ \end{aligned} \right.\tag{3}$$

$$\Rightarrow \left\{ \begin{aligned} &C = - \frac{kv}{\eta} \\ &D = v_{0} \end{aligned} \right. \Rightarrow v = \frac{v_{0}}{1 + \frac{kd}{\eta}}\tag{4}$$

代回得到:

$$u = - \frac{k v_{0}}{\eta + k d} x + v_{0}$$

(5)

(1.2) 边界条件变为:

$$- \eta \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} \bigg|_{x = d} = \sigma \frac{\partial v}{\partial t}\tag{6}$$

$$\Rightarrow u = v_{0}, v = v_{0}\tag{7}$$

(1.3)边界条件为:

· 无质量情况:

$$\left\{ \begin{aligned} & u_{(0)} = A \cos \omega t \\ & - \eta \frac{\partial u_{(d)}}{\partial x} = k u_{(d)} \end{aligned} \right.\tag{8}$$

·无受力情况:

$$\left\{ \begin{array} { l } u _ { ( 0 ) } = A \cos \omega t \\ - \eta \frac { \partial u _ { ( d ) } } { \partial x } = \sigma \frac { \partial u _ { ( d ) } } { \partial t } \end{array} \right.\tag{9}$$

满足方程:

$$\eta \frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial x^{2}} = \rho \frac{\partial u}{\partial t}\tag{10}$$

(2)

(2.1)

$$\mathrm{d}U = L \frac{\partial I}{\partial t} \mathrm{d}x\tag{11}$$

$$\mathrm{d}I = G U \mathrm{d}x\tag{12}$$

$$\Rightarrow \left\{ \begin{matrix} { \frac { \partial ^ { 2 } U } { \partial x ^ { 2 } } = L G \frac { \partial U } { \partial t } } \\ { \frac { \partial ^ { 2 } I } { \partial x ^ { 2 } } = L G \frac { \partial I } { \partial t } } \\ \end{matrix} \right.\tag{13}$$

可见方程形式一致，参数需满足关系: $LG = \varrho$

(2.2)

对无质量情况，边界条件为 $- \eta \frac{\partial u_{(d)}}{\partial x} = k u_{(d)}$ ，以I作为u观察I，U变化关系，一端连接一电阻时，有:

$$U = IR_{1} \Rightarrow \frac{\partial I}{\partial x} = GIR_{1}\tag{14}$$

需满足:

$$G R _ { 1 } = - \frac { k } { \eta }\tag{15}$$

另一端为交变电流源 $I = I_{0} \cos \omega t$

$$I_{0} = v_{0}\tag{16}$$

对无外力情况，边界条件为 $- \eta \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \sigma \frac{\partial u}{\partial t}$ ，以U作为u仍旧在一端连接电阻，有:

$$I = \frac{\overline{U}}{R_{2}} \Rightarrow \frac{\partial \overline{U}}{\partial x} = \frac{L}{R_{2}} \frac{\partial \overline{U}}{\partial t}\tag{17}$$

需满足:

$$\frac{L}{R_{2}}=-\frac{\sigma}{\eta}\tag{18}$$

另一端为交变电压源 $U = U_{0} \cos \omega t$

$$U_{0} = v_{0}\tag{19}$$

(3）在右侧接一个电阻R即可，令长度为 $d ,$ 有:

$$U_{x,t} = U' e^{\mathrm{j} \omega t}\tag{20}$$

$$\Rightarrow \frac{\partial^{2} U'}{\partial x^{2}} = - \mathrm{j} \omega \frac{\rho}{\eta} U'\tag{21}$$

$$u = ( A e ^ { \sqrt { - \mathrm { j } \omega \frac { \rho } { \eta } } x } + B e ^ { - \sqrt { - \mathrm { j } \omega \frac { \rho } { \eta } } x } ) e ^ { \mathrm { j } \omega t }\tag{22}$$

Part B

(1)

对两摆分别列水平受力方程

$$m \ddot { \theta } _ { 1 } l = - m g \theta _ { 1 } - k l \left( \theta _ { 1 } - \theta _ { 2 } \right)\tag{23}$$

$$m\ddot{\theta}_{2}l = -mg\theta_{2} - kl\left( \theta_{2} - \theta_{1} \right)\tag{24}$$

(2)

如图1所示，列出两个回路的基尔霍夫方程

$$L\ddot{Q}_{1}=-\frac{\dot{Q}_{1}}{C}-\frac{\dot{Q}_{1}-\dot{Q}_{2}}{C^{\prime}}\tag{25}$$

$$L\ddot{Q}_{2}=-\frac{Q_{2}}{C}-\frac{Q_{2}-Q_{1}}{C^{\prime}}\tag{26}$$

![](data/images/2024-39573c51/2024-启慧研习院-力学-答案-电磁学十力学-2.jpg)

图1

观察(1)与(2)的方程，得到类比关系

$$Q_{1} \rightarrow \theta_{1}, Q_{2} \rightarrow \theta_{2}\tag{27}$$

$$\frac{1}{LC} \rightarrow \frac{g}{l}, \frac{1}{LC'} \rightarrow \frac{k}{m}\tag{28}$$

(合理即得分)

(3)

将力学模型类比为电学模型，如图2所示:

![](data/images/2024-39573c51/2024-启慧研习院-力学-答案-电磁学十力学-3.jpg)

图2

有 $\theta_{n} \rightarrow Q_{n}, \frac{g}{l} \rightarrow \frac{1}{LC}, \frac{k}{m} \rightarrow \frac{1}{LC'}$

计算上右图阻抗，利用自相似

$$\frac{1}{\mathrm{j} \omega C} + \mathrm{j} \omega L + \frac{1}{\mathrm{j} \omega C' + \frac{1}{Z}} = Z\tag{29}$$

$$Z = \frac{\frac{\mathcal{Q}'}{C} - \omega^2LC' \pm \sqrt{\left(\frac{\mathcal{Q}'}{C} - \omega^2LC'\right)^2 + 4\left(1 - \omega^2LC'\right)}}{2\mathrm{j}\omega C'}\tag{30}$$

可以看出，若能量转移振荡发生，则对外来看必然存在能量损耗，这所以Z应该存在实部

$$\left( \frac { C ^ { \prime } } { C } - \omega ^ { 2 } L C ^ { \prime } \right) ^ { 2 } + 4 \left( 1 - \omega ^ { 2 } L C ^ { \prime } \right) < 0\tag{31}$$

$$\frac { 1 } { L C ^ { \prime } } \left( 2 + \frac { C ^ { \prime } } { C } - 2 \sqrt { \frac { C ^ { \prime } } { C } } \right) < \omega ^ { 2 } < \frac { 1 } { L C ^ { \prime } } \left( 2 + \frac { C ^ { \prime } } { C } + 2 \sqrt { \frac { C ^ { \prime } } { C } } \right)\tag{32}$$

换回力学量

$$\sqrt { \frac { k } { m } } \sqrt { 2 + \frac { k l } { m g } - 2 \sqrt { \frac { k l } { m g } } } < \omega < \sqrt { \frac { k } { m } } \sqrt { 2 + \frac { k l } { m g } + 2 \sqrt { \frac { k l } { m g } } } .\tag{33}$$

(11) 先求两种情况下的涡旋电场分布.

螺线管连接电源时，记其截面上磁通量为 $\phi$. 则总磁通为 $N\phi$，由法拉第电磁感应定律
questions.analysis:
$$N \frac{d\phi}{dt} = -\xi \tag{①}$$

(a) $R < r < L$ 处的涡旋电场. 同样由法拉第电磁感应定律可得

$$\frac{d\phi}{dt} = - E_{r} \cdot 2\pi r \tag{②}$$

联立①②得涡旋电场分布(选取方向可使值为正)

$$\overline{E_{r}} = \frac{\xi}{2\pi r} \hat{\theta} \tag{③}$$

(b) $r>L$ 处，螺线管可视为磁偶极子. 磁矩

$$m = N \cdot I \cdot \pi R^{2} \tag{④}$$

其中电流满足

$$\phi = L I \tag{⑤}$$

$L$ 为螺线管自感系数

$$L = \mu_0 \frac{\pi N^{2} R^{2}}{l} \tag{⑥}$$

⑤⑥代入①解得

$$I = \frac{\xi t}{\mu_0 \pi N^{2} R^{2}} \tag{⑦}$$

代回④得

$$m = \frac{\xi L t}{\mu_0 N} \tag{⑧}$$

在 $r \gg l$ 处产生垂直于 $(r,\theta)$ 平面、且与管内方向相反的磁感强度

$$B = \frac{\mu_0 m}{4\pi r^{3}} \tag{⑨}$$

易见 $(r,\theta)$ 平面上总磁通为0. 故半径 $0\sim r$ 范围内总磁通

$$\phi(0 \sim r) = -\phi(r \sim \infty) = -\int_{r}^{\infty} B(r) \cdot 2\pi r \, dr \tag{⑩}$$

由法拉第电磁感应定律

$$\frac{d\phi(0 \sim r)}{dt} = - E_{\theta} \cdot 2\pi r \tag{⑪}$$

代入得

$$\vec{E}_{\theta} = \frac{\xi L}{4\pi N r^{2}} \hat{\theta} \tag{⑫}$$

静电场

$$\vec{E}_{r} = \frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}} \frac{Q}{r^{2}} \hat{r} \tag{⑬}$$

要使小球速率恒定，轨道处处与合电场垂直，有:

$$(E_{r}, E_{\theta}) \cdot (dr, r d\theta) = 0 \tag{⑭}$$

(a) ③⑬代入⑭解得

$$r = \frac{\sqrt{a}}{2\cos\delta} \cdot \frac{1}{\theta - \theta_{0}} \quad 或 \quad \theta = \frac{\sqrt{a}}{2\cos\delta} \cdot \frac{1}{r} + \theta_{0} \tag{⑮}$$

其中 $\theta_0$ 为积分常数.

(b) ⑫⑬代入⑭解得

$$\theta = -\frac{\pi\alpha}{8\varepsilon\sqrt{\varepsilon}} \ln r \quad 或 \quad r = r_{0} e^{-\frac{8\varepsilon\sqrt{\varepsilon}}{\pi\alpha}\theta} \tag{⑯}$$

其中 $r_0$ 为积分常数

(1.2) $r \rightarrow +\infty$ 时 $\theta \rightarrow -\infty$ 一直旋转下去. 故无渐近线

(2.1) 未受微扰时，由平衡解出半径

$$\frac{k\alpha\beta}{r_{0}^{2}} = m \omega_{0}^{2} r_{0} \Rightarrow r_{0} = \sqrt[3]{\frac{k\alpha\beta}{m\omega_{0}^{2}}} \tag{⑱}$$

列出通电微扰后一般的动力学方程

径向方程:

$$m(\ddot{r} - r\dot{\theta}^{2}) = -\frac{k\alpha\beta}{r^{2}} \tag{⑲}$$

对原点角动量定理:

$$\frac{dL}{dt} = \frac{d}{dt}(m r^{2} \dot{\theta}) = r \cdot \dot{\theta} \cdot \frac{\xi}{2\pi\sqrt{r}} = \frac{\xi \dot{\theta}}{2\pi\sqrt{r}} \tag{⑳}$$

⑳对 $t$ 积分:

$$L = m r^{2} \dot{\theta} = L_{0} + \frac{\xi \theta_{0}}{2\pi r^{2}\omega} \sin\omega t \tag{㉑}$$

其中 $L_{0} = L(0)$ 为未微扰时的角动量:

$$L_{0} = m r_{0}^{2} \omega_{0} = \left(\frac{k^{2}\alpha^{2}\beta^{2} m}{\omega_{0}}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}} \tag{㉒}$$

由㉑:

$$\dot{\theta} = \frac{1}{m r^{2}}\left(L_{0} + \frac{\xi \theta_{0}}{2\pi r^{2}\omega} \sin\omega t\right) \tag{㉓}$$

㉓代入⑲，整理得 $r(t)$ 满足的微分方程:

$$\frac{\ddot{r}}{r} - \frac{\left(L_{0} + \frac{\xi\theta_{0}}{2\pi r^{2}\omega}\sin\omega t\right)^{2}}{m^{2} r^{4}} = -\frac{k\alpha\beta}{m r^{3}} \tag{㉔}$$

$\omega \gg \omega_{0}$，$\frac{\xi\theta_{0}}{2\pi r^{2}\omega} < L_{0}$ 时为高频微扰

记

$$r = r_{0} + \Delta r \sin\omega t \tag{㉕}$$

代入㉔:

$$-\omega^{2}\Delta r \sin\omega t + \frac{L_{0}^{2}}{m^{2} r_{0}^{4}}\left(1 + \frac{\xi\theta_{0}}{2\pi r_{0}^{2}\omega L_{0}}\sin\omega t\right)\left(1 - 4\frac{\Delta r}{r_{0}}\sin\omega t\right) = -\frac{k\alpha\beta}{m r_{0}^{3}}\left(1 - 3\frac{\Delta r}{r_{0}}\sin\omega t\right) \tag{㉖}$$

㉖代入化简，两边同除以 $\sin\omega t$，保留最低阶，得

$$-\omega^{2}\Delta r + \frac{L_{0}^{2}}{m^{2} r_{0}^{4}}\left(\frac{\xi\theta_{0}}{2\pi r_{0}^{2}\omega L_{0}} - 4\frac{\Delta r}{r_{0}}\right) = \frac{3k\alpha\beta}{m r_{0}^{4}}\Delta r \tag{㉗}$$

解得

$$\Delta r = \frac{\xi\theta_{0} L_{0}}{2\pi m^{2} r_{0}^{6}\omega\left(\omega^{2} - \frac{3k\alpha\beta}{m r_{0}^{4}} - \frac{4L_{0}^{2}}{m^{2} r_{0}^{6}}\right)} \tag{㉘}$$

代入㉕得:

$$\Delta r = -\frac{1}{\pi N} \sqrt[3]{\frac{m\omega_{0}^{2}}{k\alpha\beta}} \cdot \frac{\xi\theta_{0}\omega_{0}}{m\omega(\omega^{2} - \omega_{0}^{2})} \tag{㉙}$$

㉙代回㉕即

$$r(t) = \sqrt[3]{\frac{k\alpha\beta}{m\omega_{0}^{2}}} - \frac{1}{\pi N} \sqrt[3]{\frac{m\omega_{0}^{2}}{k\alpha\beta}} \cdot \frac{\xi\theta_{0}\omega_{0}}{m\omega(\omega^{2} - \omega_{0}^{2})} \cdot \sin\omega t \tag{㉚}$$

(2.2) $\omega \ll \omega_{0}$，$\frac{\xi\theta_{0}}{2\pi r^{2}\omega} \ll L_{0}$ 时，为低频微扰，相当于使平方反比场中的周期运动发生缓变，可能变为椭圆轨道. 记半长轴为 $a$.

由开普勒第三定律知周期

$$T = 2\pi \sqrt{\frac{m a^{3}}{k\alpha\beta}} \tag{㉛}$$

$a$ 由总能量 $E$ 决定

$$E = -\frac{k\alpha\beta}{2a} \Rightarrow a = -\frac{k\alpha\beta}{2E} \tag{㉜}$$

㉜代㉛:

$$T = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\pi k\alpha\beta \sqrt{\frac{-m}{E^{3}}} \tag{㉝}$$

考虑一个周期内的变化. 由⑫知，涡旋电场力矩:

$$M = \frac{\xi\theta_{0}}{2\pi N} \cos\omega t$$

$\omega \ll \omega_{0}$，1个 $T$ 内 $\cos\omega t \approx const.$ 系统能量增加

$$\Delta E = \int M d\theta = 2\pi M = \frac{\xi\theta_{0}}{N} \cos\omega t \tag{㉞}$$

联立㉝㉞得能量平均变化率

$$\frac{dE}{dt} = \frac{\Delta E}{T} = \frac{\sqrt{2}E_{0}}{\pi\sqrt{k\alpha\beta}} \sqrt{\frac{E^{3}}{m}} \cos\omega t \tag{㉟}$$

$$\Rightarrow (-E)^{-\frac{3}{2}} \cdot d(-E) = -\frac{\sqrt{2}\xi\theta_{0}}{\pi N \sqrt{k\alpha\beta}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{m}} \cos\omega t \, dt \tag{㊱}$$

积分得

$$\frac{1}{\sqrt{-E}} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{-E_{0}}} = \frac{\xi\theta_{0}\sin\omega t}{\pi\sqrt{k\alpha\beta}\omega\sqrt{2m}}$$

其中 $E_{0} = -\frac{k\alpha\beta}{2r_{0}} = -\frac{1}{2}\sqrt[3]{k^{2}\alpha^{2}\beta^{2}\omega_{0}^{2} m}$，整理得:

$$E(t) = -\left(\sqrt{2} \cdot (k^{2}\alpha^{2}\beta^{2}\omega^{2} m)^{-\frac{1}{6}} + \frac{\xi\theta_{0}\sin\omega t}{\pi\sqrt{k\alpha\beta}\omega\sqrt{2m}}\right)^{-2} \tag{㊲}$$

角动量，㉑代入得

$$L(t) = \left(\frac{k^{2}\alpha^{2}\beta^{2} m}{\omega_{0}}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}} + \frac{\xi\theta_{0}\sin\omega t}{2\pi\sqrt{\omega}} \tag{㊳}$$

$$m(\ddot{r} - r\dot{\theta}^{2}) = -\frac{k\alpha\beta}{r^{2}} \tag{⑲}$$

对原点角动量定理:

$$\frac{dL}{dt} = \frac{d}{dt}(m r^{2} \dot{\theta}) = r \cdot \dot{\theta} \cdot \frac{\xi}{2\pi\sqrt{r}} = \frac{\xi \dot{\theta}}{2\pi\sqrt{r}} \tag{⑳}$$

⑳对 $t$ 积分:

$$L = m r^{2} \dot{\theta} = L_{0} + \frac{\xi \theta_{0}}{2\pi r^{2}\omega} \sin\omega t \tag{㉑}$$

其中 $L_{0} = L(0)$ 为未微扰时的角动量:

$$L_{0} = m r_{0}^{2} \omega_{0} = \left(\frac{k^{2}\alpha^{2}\beta^{2} m}{\omega_{0}}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}} \tag{㉒}$$

由㉑:

$$\dot{\theta} = \frac{1}{m r^{2}}\left(L_{0} + \frac{\xi \theta_{0}}{2\pi r^{2}\omega} \sin\omega t\right) \tag{㉓}$$

㉓代入⑲，整理得 $r(t)$ 满足的微分方程:

$$\frac{\ddot{r}}{r} - \frac{\left(L_{0} + \frac{\xi\theta_{0}}{2\pi r^{2}\omega}\sin\omega t\right)^{2}}{m^{2} r^{4}} = -\frac{k\alpha\beta}{m r^{3}} \tag{㉔}$$

$\omega \gg \omega_{0}$，$\frac{\xi\theta_{0}}{2\pi r^{2}\omega} < L_{0}$ 时为高频微扰

记

$$r = r_{0} + \Delta r \sin\omega t \tag{㉕}$$

代入㉔:

$$-\omega^{2}\Delta r \sin\omega t + \frac{L_{0}^{2}}{m^{2} r_{0}^{4}}\left(1 + \frac{\xi\theta_{0}}{2\pi r_{0}^{2}\omega L_{0}}\sin\omega t\right)\left(1 - 4\frac{\Delta r}{r_{0}}\sin\omega t\right) = -\frac{k\alpha\beta}{m r_{0}^{3}}\left(1 - 3\frac{\Delta r}{r_{0}}\sin\omega t\right) \tag{㉖}$$

㉖代入化简，两边同除以 $\sin\omega t$，保留最低阶，得

$$-\omega^{2}\Delta r + \frac{L_{0}^{2}}{m^{2} r_{0}^{4}}\left(\frac{\xi\theta_{0}}{2\pi r_{0}^{2}\omega L_{0}} - 4\frac{\Delta r}{r_{0}}\right) = \frac{3k\alpha\beta}{m r_{0}^{4}}\Delta r \tag{㉗}$$

解得

$$\Delta r = \frac{\xi\theta_{0} L_{0}}{2\pi m^{2} r_{0}^{6}\omega\left(\omega^{2} - \frac{3k\alpha\beta}{m r_{0}^{4}} - \frac{4L_{0}^{2}}{m^{2} r_{0}^{6}}\right)} \tag{㉘}$$

代入㉕得:

$$\Delta r = -\frac{1}{\pi N} \sqrt[3]{\frac{m\omega_{0}^{2}}{k\alpha\beta}} \cdot \frac{\xi\theta_{0}\omega_{0}}{m\omega(\omega^{2} - \omega_{0}^{2})} \tag{㉙}$$

㉙代回㉕即

$$r(t) = \sqrt[3]{\frac{k\alpha\beta}{m\omega_{0}^{2}}} - \frac{1}{\pi N} \sqrt[3]{\frac{m\omega_{0}^{2}}{k\alpha\beta}} \cdot \frac{\xi\theta_{0}\omega_{0}}{m\omega(\omega^{2} - \omega_{0}^{2})} \cdot \sin\omega t \tag{㉚}$$

(2.2) $\omega \ll \omega_{0}$，$\frac{\xi\theta_{0}}{2\pi r^{2}\omega} \ll L_{0}$ 时，为低频微扰，相当于使平方反比场中的周期运动发生缓变，可能变为椭圆轨道. 记半长轴为 $a$.

由开普勒第三定律知周期

$$T = 2\pi \sqrt{\frac{m a^{3}}{k\alpha\beta}} \tag{㉛}$$

$a$ 由总能量 $E$ 决定

$$E = -\frac{k\alpha\beta}{2a} \Rightarrow a = -\frac{k\alpha\beta}{2E} \tag{㉜}$$

㉜代㉛:

$$T = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\pi k\alpha\beta \sqrt{\frac{-m}{E^{3}}} \tag{㉝}$$

考虑一个周期内的变化. 由⑫知，涡旋电场力矩:

$$M = \frac{\xi\theta_{0}}{2\pi N} \cos\omega t$$

$\omega \ll \omega_{0}$，1个 $T$ 内 $\cos\omega t \approx const.$ 系统能量增加

$$\Delta E = \int M d\theta = 2\pi M = \frac{\xi\theta_{0}}{N} \cos\omega t \tag{㉞}$$

联立㉝㉞得能量平均变化率

$$\frac{dE}{dt} = \frac{\Delta E}{T} = \frac{\sqrt{2}E_{0}}{\pi\sqrt{k\alpha\beta}} \sqrt{\frac{E^{3}}{m}} \cos\omega t \tag{㉟}$$

$$\Rightarrow (-E)^{-\frac{3}{2}} \cdot d(-E) = -\frac{\sqrt{2}\xi\theta_{0}}{\pi N \sqrt{k\alpha\beta}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{m}} \cos\omega t \, dt \tag{㊱}$$

积分得

$$\frac{1}{\sqrt{-E}} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{-E_{0}}} = \frac{\xi\theta_{0}\sin\omega t}{\pi\sqrt{k\alpha\beta}\omega\sqrt{2m}}$$

其中 $E_{0} = -\frac{k\alpha\beta}{2r_{0}} = -\frac{1}{2}\sqrt[3]{k^{2}\alpha^{2}\beta^{2}\omega_{0}^{2} m}$，整理得:

$$E(t) = -\left(\sqrt{2} \cdot (k^{2}\alpha^{2}\beta^{2}\omega^{2} m)^{-\frac{1}{6}} + \frac{\xi\theta_{0}\sin\omega t}{\pi\sqrt{k\alpha\beta}\omega\sqrt{2m}}\right)^{-2} \tag{㊲}$$

角动量，㉑代入得

$$L(t) = \left(\frac{k^{2}\alpha^{2}\beta^{2} m}{\omega_{0}}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}} + \frac{\xi\theta_{0}\sin\omega t}{2\pi\sqrt{\omega}} \tag{㊳}$$
